column1: # Sovereign Intelligence 1.0 Declarative Local Model Router Table (apps/om-route/om_route.om)
# Zero hardcoded user paths; loopback backends only (http://127.0.0.1:<port> or http://localhost:<port>).
#   model_id      exact API model identifier exposed in /v1/models and matched on /v1/chat/completions & /v1/messages
#   idle_unload_s idle timeout in seconds before SIGTERM auto-unload of spawned backend (0 = never unload)
#   max_watts     maximum allowed package power budget in Watts for thermal/power admission
#   max_tgpu_mc   maximum allowed live TGPU temperature in millidegrees C (e.g. 85000 = 85.0 C)
#   launch_cmd    '-' for externally managed backend, or argv command to launch on demand
